title: Projectile Motion
description: Interactive kinematic lab simulating 2D trajectory, gravity, air resistance, launch angle, initial velocity, and vector components.
default_instruction: Adjust initial velocity and angle to observe how horizontal and vertical velocity components evolve independently.

title: Circuit Construction Kit: DC
description: Build electrical circuits with batteries, resistors, light bulbs, capacitors, switches, Ohm's law, and Kirchhoff's loop voltage rules.
default_instruction: Connect a resistor and battery in series and use the voltmeter to verify Ohm's law (V = IR).

title: Wave Interference
description: Simulate water waves, sound waves, and light waves showing constructive and destructive interference, diffraction, wavelength, and frequency.
default_instruction: Set two slit sources and observe the interference fringe patterns formed by wave superposition.

title: Molecule Shapes (VSEPR)
description: Explore 3D molecular geometry, electron domains, lone pairs, bond angles, and VSEPR theory.
default_instruction: Add single bonds and lone pairs to observe how electron repulsion dictates 3D geometric angles.

title: Acid-Base Solutions
description: Test equilibrium concentrations, pH scale, hydronium and hydroxide ion ratios for strong and weak acids and bases.
default_instruction: Compare dissociation of strong vs weak acids to see how hydronium equilibrium impacts pH.

title: Energy Skate Park: Conservation of Energy
description: Conservation of mechanical energy, conversion between kinetic and potential energy, friction, and thermal loss.
default_instruction: Observe the bar chart of kinetic vs potential energy as the skater loops through frictionless tracks.

title: Derivatives & Tangent Line Approximations
description: Interactive calculus graph showing secant lines converging to tangent lines, instantaneous rate of change, limits, and derivative slopes.
default_instruction: Slide delta x toward zero to observe the secant line snap directly to the derivative tangent line.

title: Eigenvalues & 2D Matrix Transformations
description: Visualize 2x2 matrix transformations on unit eigenvectors, determinant area scaling, coordinate shearing, and null spaces.
default_instruction: Adjust matrix components to see which vectors maintain their direction under transformation (eigenvectors).

title: Fourier Series & Harmonic Synthesis
description: Harmonic decomposition of square and sawtooth waves using trigonometric polynomial sums, Gibbs phenomenon, and frequency harmonics.
default_instruction: Increase number of harmonics N to observe the Fourier series converge to the square wave.

title: Probability Distributions & Central Limit Theorem
description: Gaussian normal distribution, standard deviation, binomial distributions, probability density functions (PDF), and variance.
default_instruction: Vary standard deviation sigma and mean mu to watch the probability density curve scale and shift.

title: Python Recursion & Stack Frame Visualizer
description: Call stack frames, recursive branching, function call activation records, return values, call stack unwinding, and base conditions.
default_instruction: Step forward through execution to watch stack frames push during recursive calls and pop upon returning.

title: Graph Traversal (BFS & DFS) Interactive Sandbox
description: Breadth-First Search (queue-based level order), Depth-First Search (stack/recursive), visited state, spanning trees, and graph connectivity.
default_instruction: Run DFS vs BFS step-by-step from node 0 to contrast recursive backtracking with queue frontier exploration.

title: SQL Relational Joins & Set Operations
description: Interactive relational algebra demonstrating INNER JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, FULL OUTER JOIN, and Venn diagram set intersections.
default_instruction: Switch join modes between INNER and FULL OUTER to see matching vs NULL-padded row projections.

title: Sorting Algorithms Visualizer (Merge, Quick, Heap)
description: Comparative time and space complexity, divide-and-conquer recurrences, in-place partitioning, and element comparison animations.
default_instruction: Compare Quicksort recursion depth and partition pivots against Merge Sort merge steps.

title: Binary Search Trees & AVL Balancing
description: Binary search tree invariants, left/right child ordering, logarithmic search complexity, node insertions, deletions, and tree rotations.
default_instruction: Insert ordered elements to create a degenerate skewed tree, then compare search steps against a balanced tree.

title: Membrane Transport & Osmosis
description: Diffusion across semipermeable lipid bilayers, facilitated transport channels, osmotic pressure, and concentration gradients.
default_instruction: Open gated protein channels and watch solute concentrations equalize across the cell membrane.
